paragraphs: Hyman writes: “We shall bring every place where Eliyahu is mentioned in the Talmud and divide them into three parts.”
Stories about him; his sayings; what is said about him.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied source is an introductory division of Eliyahu material into three categories. The lists of stories, sayings and passages themselves are not included in this source version; this translation does not supply a complete Eliyahu biography.

The introductory נביא means “we shall bring.” The announcement and the following three categories are Hyman’s plan for a collection. Only the supplied introduction is translated; it does not contain the lists themselves and does not establish complete coverage of all Eliyahu passages.
